item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): 'Big Elephant' scam boss faces jail in Singapore for allegedly sending runners to collect victims' gold
item.description: A Malaysian man accused of masterminding a scam and money laundering syndicate in Singapore was charged in court there on Sept. 23, a day after Malaysian police arrested him and handed him over.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): VNVC, Pfizer expand cooperation to strengthen Vietnam's vaccine capabilities
item.description: VNVC and Pfizer plan to expand cooperation on vaccination and disease prevention as Vietnam develops domestic vaccine manufacturing capacity, including plans to assess production of new-generation vaccines.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): 3-month excavation uncovers 664 sets of soldiers' remains beneath Ho Chi Minh City park
item.description: A total of 664 sets of war martyrs' remains have been recovered at Le Thi Rieng Park in Ho Chi Minh City after three months of search and excavation, according to the municipal Military High Command.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Son of world's richest monarch pleads to come home for emergency brain surgery
item.description: Dr. Chakriwat Vivacharawongse, the estranged third son of Thai King Maha Vajiralongkorn, is appealing to return home from Malaysia for emergency surgery on two large brain tumors.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): MIT ends Princeton's 15-year reign to top US university rankings
item.description: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology topped the latest U.S. News & World Report national university rankings, ending Princeton University's 15-year reign at number one.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Vietnam's largest island Phu Quoc plans parking for nearly 90 aircraft ahead of APEC 2027
item.description: The Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam (CAAV) has proposed adjustments to the planning of several facilities at Phu Quoc International Airport in the Mekong Delta province of An Giang to serve the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting 2027 (APEC 2027).

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Traveler forgets $55,000 gold Rolex at Vietnam airport security, gets it back as his flight boards
item.description: Border gate police at Da Nang International Airport took under 30 minutes to trace the Chinese owner of a gold Rolex left at security screening.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Foreign tourists sip beer in floodwater as heavy rain swamps Ho Chi Minh City center
item.description: More than an hour of heavy rain left Le Loi and Ham Nghi streets and Bui Vien backpacker street in central Ho Chi Minh City under deep water on Wednesday afternoon, snarling traffic as office workers and foreign tourists waded through the flood.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): 100-year-old seaside church is Vietnam's first climate change heritage site
item.description: An abandoned church by Hai Ly Beach in the northern Vietnam's Ninh Binh Province, whose bell tower now stands next to the sea, has been recognized as a "climate change heritage tourism site."

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Ho Chi Minh City braces for continued heavy rain and flooding amid high tides
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City and neighboring provinces will face continued heavy downpours through Friday, exacerbating flood risks as the severe weather collides with rising high tides.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Hope Foundation, Long Chau launch cancer treatment support program
item.description: Hope Foundation, Long Chau pharmacy and vaccination network, and pharmaceutical partners launched the "Sharing the Burden for Cancer Patients" program on Sept. 16.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): HCMC road map to switch to electric vehicles not feasible, experts warn
item.description: Many experts argue that Ho Chi Minh City's proposed road map to control traffic emissions is hasty and difficult to practically implement.
